Police Seize Motorcycle Modified With Over 100 Horns

Haridwar police in Uttarakhand seized a motorcycle modified with over 100 horns. The vehicle was also issued a challan (fine). A video of the modified bike and its seizure by the police went viral, sparking discussion online. The exact number of horns was reported as over 100 by some outlets and as 500 by another.
